name: Haitong Unitrust International Financial Leasing Co., Ltd.
summary: Haitong Unitrust International Financial Leasing Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates as a financial leasing company in the People's Republic of China. It offers operating leasing services, and commercial factoring business, as well as advisory services; commercial and vehicle financing services; and aircraft leasing services. The company also engages in financing of aircraft-related business; and PPP project management businesses. In addition, it provides financial leasing and other services to enterprises engaging in cultural education, tourism, and hotel operations.
